iconos.title: glyphflow — animated Lucide icons for Angular
iconos.tituloConConteo: glyphflow — {{n}} animated Lucide icons for Angular
iconos.descripcion: Browse the full catalog of animated Lucide icons for Angular. Hover to preview, click to copy the code, and import only the icons you use: one costs under 6 KB.

patrones.title: Examples — animated icon controls with code | glyphflow
patrones.descripcion: Real UI controls — menus, toggles, notifications — with the exact code that animates them, side by side. Copy a pattern and drop it into your Angular app.

editor.title: Path editor — edit icon outlines point by point | glyphflow
editor.descripcion: Edit an icon's outline node by node in the path editor, then hand the result straight to the choreography editor to animate it with glyphflow in Angular.

lab.title: Lab — authoring benches for animated icons | glyphflow
lab.descripcion: Where default animation values get decided — durations, easings, and morph steps, tuned against real icons. Try the benches glyphflow uses to set its defaults.

faceLab.title: Face Lab — compare face options for the bots | glyphflow
faceLab.descripcion: Twelve face hypotheses for the glyphflow bots, compared on the same shape, color and expression, so you can pick the face that reads best before you use it.

docsEmpezando.title: Getting started — install, paint your first icon | glyphflow
docsEmpezando.descripcion: Install glyphflow with one command and animate your first icon in a few lines, no animation library required. Works with Angular 20, 21 and 22, MIT licensed.

docsAccesibilidad.title: Accessibility — one rule for animated icons | glyphflow
docsAccesibilidad.descripcion: How glyphflow handles decorative vs. semantic icons, reduced motion, and keyboard navigation: one rule, not a matrix, so you never combine flags by hand.

docsSsr.title: SSR — render animated icons without window | glyphflow
docsSsr.descripcion: glyphflow renders on the server with zero access to window or document — verified, not assumed. See what it does on the server and why there is no flicker.

docsApi.title: API — every input, output and type exported | glyphflow
docsApi.descripcion: Every input, output, and type glyphflow exports, with the guarantees that come with each one. The full public surface of the library, on a single page.

docsMigracion.title: Migration — what changed and what still works | glyphflow
docsMigracion.descripcion: Upgrading between glyphflow major versions — what changed and how to update your code. The v1 names still work, and this page says until when they do.

docsComparativa.title: Comparison — measured against the alternatives | glyphflow
docsComparativa.descripcion: glyphflow against lucide-angular, ng-icons, and Lottie — bundle weight, tree-shaking, and SSR support, measured with the method and versions listed on the page.

docsVerificar.title: Verify your bundle — reproduce the numbers | glyphflow
docsVerificar.descripcion: Confirm your build only ships the icons you actually import, not the full catalog. Reproduce glyphflow's bundle numbers yourself with a few short commands.

docsProblemas.title: Troubleshooting — icons that do not animate | glyphflow
docsProblemas.descripcion: Common glyphflow issues and their fixes, from a blank icon to a broken build: icons that never animate, morphs that look wrong, empty name= and SSR failures.

docsTemas.title: Theming and color — currentColor, dark mode | glyphflow
docsTemas.descripcion: How glyphflow tokens interact with your app's light and dark themes: inherit currentColor, switch to dark mode and control the stroke width of every icon.

bots.title: Bots — animated characters for Angular | glyphflow
bots.descripcion: Animated characters with real physical motion on the native Web Animations API. Play with one, try its 20 gestures and watch it react to an AI agent live.

docsBots.title: Using bots — shapes, gestures and AI agents | glyphflow
docsBots.descripcion: Install, shapes, gestures, customization and how to connect an AI agent to the glyphflow bots, with the Vercel AI SDK or Anthropic. Each piece imports alone.
